data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘aioō’, meaning ‘to give life’. In Greek mythology, Aia was the goddess of prophecy, identified with the Roman goddess Aurora. The name Aia carries the meaning “Breathed life” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aia usually hope their child will grow to embody breathed life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings and the promise of a bright future.
data.etymology: Aia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breathed life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aia total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
